scenarios.title: Efficiency Check
scenarios.predictionPrompt: Does a lower power rating alone establish greater efficiency?
predictions: Yes; lower watts always mean greater efficiency
No; useful output and total input must be compared
Useful and total energy are always the same
scenarios.explanationPrompt: Calculate useful output divided by input times 100; explain why lower power alone does not establish efficiency.
scenarios.keyIdea: Efficiency compares useful output with total input. Power is a rate and does not by itself give this fraction.
scenarios.teacherReasoning: Useful/input = 900/1500 × 100 = 60%. The remaining 600 J is still energy, less useful for this purpose.
